chunks: hearts are drawn to You, necks are stretched, eyes are fixed, steps are in motion, and bodies have turned lean.
ai.seo_question: What is the supplication recited by Imam Ali when facing the enemy?
ai.summary: This invocation, recorded in Nahj al-Balagha, captures the profound spiritual intensity of Imam Ali (AS) during the Battle of Siffin, illustrating the synthesis of physical endurance and metaphysical focus. It reflects the Shia understanding of *muraqabah* (awareness of God) where external struggle (*jihad*) is mirrored by internal submission, a theme central to the sermons of the Ahl al-Bayt.
